title: How to understand lab results
publisher: MedlinePlus, U.S. National Library of Medicine
summary: Laboratories may use different methods and reference ranges. A result outside a reference range does not by itself establish a diagnosis, and a result within range does not guarantee good health. A clinician considers the test in the context of the person's health and other information.

title: Preventing the spread of infection
publisher: Wirral Community Health and Care NHS Foundation Trust
summary: Antibiotics do not treat viral infections such as colds or influenza. Questions about a particular infection or medicine should be discussed with a qualified clinician or pharmacist.

title: Make the most of your doctor visit
publisher: MedlinePlus, U.S. National Library of Medicine
summary: Preparing questions before an appointment can help patients discuss concerns. The article also suggests bringing a list of medicines, vitamins and supplements to the appointment.
